concept: Stateless app: move sessions to ElastiCache/DynamoDB
tests: Understanding that session state must be moved off instances to survive instance replacement.
expected: Store sessions in an external store (ElastiCache for Redis or DynamoDB) — instances are stateless, any one can serve any request. Triggers: "sessions lost when Auto Scaling replaces instances", "without changing the load balancer".
why_not: Sticky sessions with local disk still lose state on termination; disabling Auto Scaling removes self-healing; a single AZ destroys HA.
